about: Policy for Russia's LLM (the Russia-side project), v1. Agreed principles (2026-11-23): remove hate and violence against either people; send opinions about Russia or Ukraine in BOTH directions to human review; send history (and later review topics) to review; known false claims to review; keep facts whoever they hurt. Exceptions are checked first. See cmds/labeling/russia_llm.md.

exceptions.note: 'our country' without naming it: the model could learn a national voice nobody can identify. Review first; switch to remove once measured. Quoted speech (a named speaker) does not count.

involves_russia_ukraine.hypothesis: This text mentions Russia, Ukraine, Russians or Ukrainians.
involves_russia_ukraine.note: Gate: below the threshold and no marker = the keyword was incidental (pass). Low on purpose: opinions must reach level 2.

history.hypothesis: This text is about the history of Russia or Ukraine.
history.note: Review topic (extendable: religion, language, borders ... as more review subjects).

politics.hypothesis: This text is about politics or government in Russia or Ukraine.

war.hypothesis: This text is about the war between Russia and Ukraine.
war.note: Reporting only; facts about the war are kept whoever they hurt.

economy.hypothesis: This text is about the economy of Russia or Ukraine.

culture.hypothesis: This text is about Russian or Ukrainian music, films, art, literature or entertainment.

opinion_about_russia.hypothesis: This text expresses the writer's opinion about Russia.
opinion_about_russia.note: Both directions (praise and criticism) go to review: a human decides.

opinion_about_ukraine.hypothesis: This text expresses the writer's opinion about Ukraine.
opinion_about_ukraine.note: Both directions (praise and criticism) go to review: a human decides.

hostility_russians.hypothesis: This text insults or dehumanizes Russians or Russian-speaking people.
hostility_russians.note: Hate: removed. Protected: no exception lowers it.

hostility_ukrainians.hypothesis: This text insults or dehumanizes Ukrainians.
hostility_ukrainians.note: Hate: removed. Protected: no exception lowers it.

violence_call.hypothesis: This text calls for violence against Russians or Ukrainians.

claim_ukraine_in_nato.hypothesis: This text states that Ukraine is a member of NATO.
claim_ukraine_in_nato.note: Known false claim (as of 2026): review. The models cannot check truth; each known false claim needs its own label.

reports_or_debunks.hypothesis: This text reports or refutes what someone else claimed.
reports_or_debunks.note: Guard: news quoting hate or a fact-check goes to review instead of being removed.
